customer_name: A Joint-Stock Commercial Bank (某股份制商业银行)
business_problem: The bank needed a unified generative AI foundation that could support multiple banking scenarios, from customer service to insurance document question answering and developer productivity, instead of running isolated experiments with no shared large-model stack or enterprise controls.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud helped the bank build a single enterprise large-model architecture on the Qianfan Large Model Platform so model operations, application development, and banking use cases could be managed as one stack. At the infrastructure layer, the bank deployed a heterogeneous large-model service cluster to support training and inference. On top of that, Qianfan standardized the full model lifecycle, including data preparation, training, evaluation, and optimization. A development framework layer then added enterprise-grade visual debugging, prompt tuning, and document preprocessing so internal teams could adapt applications to specific financial workflows. The application layer exposed ready-to-use AI-native capabilities such as code assistants, intelligent customer service, and insurance-document knowledge retrieval. This layered design gave the bank a reusable generative AI base that connected compute, model management, document knowledge, and business-facing assistants under one governed platform.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the unified large-model lifecycle platform for training, evaluation, optimization, prompt work, and enterprise application development across banking scenarios.

data_flow: Enterprise documents and business-scene data are prepared inside Qianfan, models are trained and optimized on the bank's heterogeneous large-model cluster, and finished applications such as code assistants, insurance knowledge retrieval, and customer-service helpers deliver answers back to business teams and service agents.
business_outcome: The bank established a full generative AI technology base for business innovation, with measurable gains in development productivity, insurance knowledge retrieval coverage, and customer-service recommendation quality.
metrics: knowledge recommendation accuracy improved from 30% to 60%+
average call duration reduced by 15 seconds
architecture_clues: The architecture is layered from heterogeneous training and inference clusters up through model management, application development, and business-facing assistants.
The platform includes enterprise document preprocessing and scene-specific visual debugging for large-model applications.

The platform builds a heterogeneous service cluster at the AI infrastructure layer and centrally manages training, evaluation, and optimization at the platform layer. (original: 基于百度智能云千帆大模型平台，在AI基础设施层，建设大模型异构服务集群;平台层，对大模型全生命周期的数据训练、评估、优化等流程进行统一管理;)

The development framework provides enterprise visual debugging and enterprise-document data preprocessing for large-model applications. (original: 开发框架层，基于对业务场景及诉求的理解，为大模型应用提供企业级的场景可视化调试、企业文档数据预处理能力等支持;)
Applying ERNIE Code Assistant across the whole development team could reduce labor costs by at least 20% each year. (original: 在代码助手场景，后续如将文心快码产品应用到全行研发团队，将至少可以实现每年20%以上的人力成本降幅；)
